jobs.title: Market Supervisory Officer
jobs.description:
Are you an expert on risk and supervision? Do you know how to make the right call in challenging situations?

We’re looking for someone like this to:

• manage all hiring and personnel decisions, coach the supervisory team and provide training on supervisory tools, new compliance bulletins and operational procedures.
• manage review of various supervision processes
• drive initiatives related to sales supervision, compliance and business risk, including implementation and education
• support branches in the Branch Review and Group Internal Audit processes, visiting branches, and working on action plans for those with failed audits
• partner with Compliance, including providing input to policy and supporting communication of policies
• serve as a point of contact for issues that cannot be resolved, and escalate issues as required

jobs.title: Unified Global Markets - Equity Sales
jobs.description:
Are you a target driven individual? Are you skilled at translating complex market information? We're looking for someone who would like to:

• provide Capital Markets solutions to wealth management clients across asset classes based on our Chief Investment Officer (CIO) House View and/or market developments.
• manages both internal and external marketing and sales efforts for Capital Markets solutions, with an emphasis on global equities such as those from Hong Kong/China, the United States, Japan, and other regions.
• maintain awareness of financial market trends, relevant news, and economic developments that may influence investment opportunities.
• prepare and deliver clear, concise, and compelling equity ideas to clients, ensuring the information is actionable and insightful.
• monitor and update clients on developments affecting key investment thesis and market conditions.
• develop top-tier equity ideas, prepare sales narratives, follow up with key updates, capable to address a wide range of client requirements.
• ensure pro-activity and proximity to the targeted markets to provide best-in-class solutions and service.
• identify potential sales, organize collaborative actions, and track progress and achievements.
• manage daily product offering processes, improve efficiency, collaborate across bank to enhance client service and experiences.

jobs.title: HF FX Sales
jobs.description:
We’re a looking for an Institutional (Hedge Fund focused) FX salesperson, Americas to:

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with institutional clients, including hedge funds and asset managers. Someone with strong existing relationships with clients.
- Drive revenue growth by actively selling a variety of FX products including spot Fx, NDF’s Swaps, Vanilla Options; Exotic options including, RKO’s. Digitals, Dual Digitals; Correaltion Swaps; Worst of Options; Window Knock out options and other exotics.
- Partner with the trading desk and research teams to provide market insights, generate actionable trade ideas, and present investment opportunities to clients.
- Collaborate and work with the Global FX trading business to drive and grow our institutional FX franchise.

titleByLocale.en: Stewardship Analyst – Corporate Governance & Active Ownership
titleByLocale.it: Stewardship Analista – Corporate Governance & Active Ownership
titleByLocale.de: Stewardship Analyst – Corporate Governance & Active Ownership

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about Sustainable Investing and in particular Investor Stewardship? Investor stewardship is a core component of UBS Asset Management’s fiduciary and sustainable investing approach. We are seeking an experienced Stewardship Analyst to strengthen our corporate governance, proxy voting and engagement capabilities across global investments.

In this role you will:

• act as a corporate governance subject matter expert, providing independent, high quality analysis on boards, executive remuneration, shareholder rights, capital structures and governance risks across global markets
• apply deep governance expertise to inform voting decisions, company engagement priorities and investment discussions
• assess company practices in a global and competitive context, including peer benchmarking and evolving governance and ESG standards
• lead end to end proxy voting research and execution, ensuring voting decisions are robust, policy aligned and clearly articulated
• demonstrate strong hands on experience with proxy voting systems, voting workflows and data quality management
• contribute to the ongoing development and application of UBS Asset Management’s global proxy voting policies
• conduct in depth engagements with senior board members and executive management on governance and material ESG topics
• engage confidently on complex and sensitive issues, including executive pay, board effectiveness, succession planning and long term strategy
• integrate broader ESG considerations into engagement activity, including climate, nature, social issues and emerging areas such as AI governance
• work closely with active and passive investment teams, ensuring stewardship insights are well integrated into investment decision making
• support portfolio managers and analysts with governance and ESG insights relevant to risk assessment and long term value creation
• contribute to stewardship reporting and respond to internal and client stewardship related queries
• help drive innovation in stewardship research and processes, including exploring opportunities to integrate AI and advanced analytics into voting and engagement research
• contribute to continuous improvement of stewardship frameworks, analytical tools and engagement practices.

jobs.description:
Client Service Associates support both clients and advisors in the following areas:
• Serve as the first point of contact by managing inbound client calls and initiating outbound calls as needed
• Schedule client meetings, maintain accurate calendars, and coordinate availability for advisors and clients
• Assist in preparing reports, presentations, and other materials for client meetings
• Process client requests and approvals, including account transactions, disbursements, and investment-related changes
• Open new accounts, gather and verify client information, and prepare and process required documentation
• Research and resolve complex or unique client inquiries in a timely and professional manner
• Prepare, track, and submit expense reports
• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of firm policies, procedures, and technology platforms

jobs.title: Transaction Manager (DCM) – Investment Banking Switzerland
jobs.description:
Are you interested in working in the dynamic field of Debt Capital Markets? Do you enjoy managing multiple transactions and thrive in a fast-paced environment? Would you like to be part of a successful, collaborative team?

We are looking for a professional to join our DCM Transaction Management team in Switzerland.

Do you want to play a key role in executing debt capital market transactions? In this position, you will:
• work in a highly professional and collaborative environment, take responsibility for the documentation and execution of a wide range of debt capital market transactions for domestic and international clients
• provide market-technical, regulatory expertise and advisory services to internal stakeholders and external clients (issuers)
• collaborate closely with issuers, internal and external legal advisors, regulatory authorities, clearing and settlement organizations, and origination teams
• coordinate all involved parties and manage tasks that arising throughout the lifecycle of a debt transaction

jobs.description:
Your role
Do you have a strategic mindset to engage with senior stakeholders? Do you have strong problem solving skills and do you enjoy bringing structure to complex situations, engage with a variety of views and stakeholders to find common solutions? Are you good at communicating complex business challenges in a constructive and easy way?

We are looking for someone who wants to:
• drive the development of the GWM strategy on a global, country, channel and product level, together with the respective businesses
• support the decision making of our internal business partners on senior management level
• conduct industry, competitor and benchmarking analyses
• design operating models and processes for specific markets and business segments
• coordinate and challenge business plans including financial modelling
• develop implementation roadmaps of strategic initiatives
• drive M&A projects from a strategic perspective (rationale, financial opportunity, due diligence, etc.)
• be open to do cross-divisional strategy projects/rotations as opportunities arise

jobs.title: Fund Accountant
jobs.description:
Do you have a strong attention to detail that enables robust accounting oversight and sound risk governance? Do you thrive in cross‑functional and multi‑regional environments? Are you a diligent, process‑driven professional with deep fund accounting expertise?
We are looking for a Fund Accountant who will play a key role in overseeing Taiwan fund accounting activities and contributing to regional initiatives.
The successful candidate will:
• Represent Taiwan Fund Accounting at both local and regional levels, and contribute to cross functional and cross regional projects
• Support and oversee fund accounting–related regulatory reporting
• Apply strong technical expertise in NAV calculation and valuation
• Demonstrate a strong risk and control mindset in overseeing fund administration vendors
• Coordinate fund financial statement audits with external auditors
• Manage trade processing, settlement, and related controls, working closely with front and middle offices to resolve trade discrepancies and mitigate operational risks
• Act as a key point of contact for external clients and internal stakeholders, responding to fund accounting–related inquiries in a timely and professional manner
• Ensure all control processes and procedures (e.g., reconciliations, payments) comply with UBS standards, internal policies, and regulatory requirements
• Support and manage fund life‑cycle events, including (but not limited to) fund launches, mergers, liquidations, and fund maturities
• Design and deliver customized reports to meet client and business requirements
• Provide support for APAC cross‑regional initiatives and tasks as required

jobs.title: FX Options E-Trading Quant Developer
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Quantitative Developer? Do you enjoy innovative thinking? We are seeking an experienced Quantitative Developer to join our Equity Derivatives Quantitative Development (EMEA) team within UBS Global Markets.

• design and deliver next-generation algorithmic trading solutions within the FX Options e-trading environment
• contribute directly to the Principal E-Trading business (covering FX, Precious Metals, Rates, Credit and Equities), building scalable and impactful trading functionality
• work as part of a high-performing quantitative development team, closely aligned with front-office business objectives
• develop and enhance systems that support electronic market making, with a strong focus on performance and reliability
• take ownership across the full software development lifecycle, from analysis and design through to implementation and production support
• collaborate closely with traders, quantitative analysts and global technology teams to deliver innovative trading capabilities
• drive improvements that have a measurable impact on revenue generation and business growth

jobs.title: Internship - External Risk Assessment
jobs.description:
Are you an analytical thinker and interested in how political and economic events impact credit risk of the bank? Are you experienced with applying macro-economic concepts and analyzing political and policy risks? At UBS, we re-imagine the way we work, the way we connect with each other - our colleagues, clients and partners - and the way we deliver value. Being agile will make us more responsive, more adaptable and ultimately more innovative.
We're looking for an intern to:
• – monitor and analyze macroeconomic, (geo)political, economic and financial risks for a group of countries, markets and sectors, and provide inputs in internal publications and processes
• – assign country risk ratings in line with internal rating guidelines and methodologies, identify emerging risks, key triggers and potential rating sensitivities in a timely manner
• – support the team in the development and maintenance of internal methodologies, data and tools for country and comparative analyses
• – interact with specialists in different areas to drive upgrades of the internal framework and processes

- prepare research reports, write thematic sector pieces, and develop investment ideas
- establish and maintain regular communication with company management teams, industry experts, clients and our internal sales teams
- engage in financial modelling, forecasting and financial statement analysis
- participate in client marketing activities.

jobs.title: Integrated Middle Office Specialist
jobs.description:
Ensure Completeness, Accuracy and Timeliness ("CAT") requirements Trade capture controls and Trade Lifecycle controls for our investment banking derivatives trades across credit business. This includes daily exceptions management of intersystem reconciliations at transaction/position/cash level, also the associated reporting activities, and ensuring appropriate escalation of items work with other TLCS (Trade & Lifecycle Controlling Services) stakeholders..

Are you inquisitive with analytical and risk-aware mindset? Do you have a F2B controls background?

We’re looking for a Middle Office Specialist to:

• •Be responsible for a suite of controls, facilitating support aimed at mitigating risk and working with other MO functions to resolve escalated issues
• •monitor and run the CSAs for SPEs as these are not managed through the bank’s collateral pool
• •Run controls on collateral and cash sitting in an SPE – Daily check in respect of any changes made to the collateral held in UBS’s SPVs
• •Actively and continually provide ideas and execute on process improvements in the exception management and data quality of submission to clients.
• •Be the subject matter expert in all team activities and support teams and peripheral stakeholders.
•Project Management activities – assisting with end-to-end support around IMO initiatives including conducting initial impact analysis, tracking for deliverables and following up with management and IMO staff.
• •Take ownership of tracking, updating issue and action logs
• •Partner with sales and trading to manage and facilitate new business initiatives
• •Participate in strategic change initiatives by acting as subject matter expert

jobs.title: GWM AML Advisor
jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned risk manager and can provide challenge to senior management in their risk decisions? Do you enjoy working in teams and contribute to the sustainable risk management of the business? Then we are looking for someone like you!

In your new role you will:
• Provide 1st line advice and policy interpretation to Markets on AML related matters in line with regulatory expectations and global/regional policies, framework and guidance; assisting Markets with the articulation and assessment of AML risks to guide Markets in their decision making.
• Provide 1st line guidance to Markets on Level 2 queries2 for individual cases, providing practical advice and potential solutions to address identified AML/CFT risks for individual cases. Where needed, supporting Markets in their discussions with DDO on escalated Level 2 cases on a prioritized basis.
• Partner with OH and C&ORC to uplift Markets capabilities on AML/CFT topics by developing materials (e.g. scenario guidance), providing relevant training, sharing feedback through lessons learnt, and sharing of industry best practices.
• Support Markets from a 1st line risk perspective in timely completion of remediation programs, including, where appropriate, providing appropriate management reporting and advice around risks, issues & dependencies.
• present key updates to management including risks, issues & dependencies in appropriate forums and provide guidance on mitigation
• be a role model to your team of risk partners
• help drive a positive risk culture throughout the organization including driving and delivering selected trainings

jobs.title: Global Markets Client Office EMEA
jobs.description:
As part of Global Markets Client Office, you will help shape and deliver our client strategy across Global Markets Distribution—driving revenue outperformance, winning market share and improving the client experience.
You’ll act as a central connector between clients and the firm, ensuring we bring the full UBS platform to clients without silo bias. You will put the client at the centre of decision making: identifying share of wallet gaps, prioritising the right opportunities, and turning insight into measurable commercial outcomes.
You will work at the intersection of data, AI, sales, trading and senior management—translating analytics into action through disciplined forums, campaigns and best in class execution. Inform. Enable. Execute.

In this role, you will:
• drive cross asset client campaigns and regional initiatives for priority clients—spot opportunities, coordinate execution and track outcomes
• deliver clear, large scale analytics on wallet gaps, campaign performance and thematic trends to inform strategy and improve results
• act as the Voice of the Client by running structured internal client reviews and forums with Sales & Trading and senior stakeholders—capturing insights, agreeing actions and ensuring follow through
• support key client deliverables across account management (firm to firm engagement, new PM onboarding, strategic discussions, escalations and ongoing connectivity)
• organise broker reviews, reverse broker reviews and client events end to end (planning, materials, logistics and actions)
• generate actionable client intelligence using advanced analytics and emerging AI tools; contribute to the design, testing and rollout of Sales AI capabilities
• produce concise, senior ready materials—briefings, performance reports and presentations that are decision oriented and easy to consume
• help build AI products that embed proactive insights, automation and decision support directly into sales workflows

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about data? Are you looking to drive key product and regulatory initiatives across banking products such as SBL, Mortgages, Cards and Deposits? We are looking for someone like that who will analyze product, Financial Advisor and client data, support product development, drive/support revenue-generating initiatives and work very closely with product management, control and support partners.

• Analyze complex business problems and issues using data from internal and external sources to provide insight to decision-makers
• Identify and interpret trends and patterns in datasets to construct recommendations for strategic/tactical sales plans

jobs.title: Head of Greater China Institutional Client Coverage

titleByLocale.en: Head of Greater China Institutional Client Coverage
titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Greater China Institutional Client Coverage
titleByLocale.de: Leiter Greater China Institutional Client Coverage
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable Greater China Institutional Client Coverage

jobs.description:
Do you have the knowledge and experience to drive the business (development) with our Greater China client base? Do you have a track record of successfully managing client relationships? Are you able to create collaborative solutions in challenging and complex situations?

If so, we are looking for a strong candidate to join our Institutional Client Coverage team in HK to lead and grow our institutional asset management business in Greater China, very much as a player / coach.

You will lead and work closely with the incumbent Client Relationship Managers in our Greater China Institutional business.
The role will focus on shaping the business strategy for Greater China and growing our institutional business in the region across the UBS AM capability set. This will be done in conjunction with the incumbents. You (and your team) will be accountable for the delivery of agreed business targets and maximise (new) client mandates by leveraging industry knowledge, internal and external contacts and relationships.

Key responsibilities
• a key role in shaping our strategy for Greater China
• player / coach in growing our Greater China business, leading and closely working with incumbents
• increase corporate & market awareness of the Greater China business, including the promotion of UBS AM at key events and roadshows as required
• contribute strongly to the team’s prospecting activity as a player. Leverage existing and new relationships to grow / diversify our book and achieve growth ambitions for the business
• work closely with the investment teams in both public and private markets, and Partnership Solutions and represent UBS Asset Management and UBS Group as such to organisations across the region
• management of the new business pipeline with the team and delivery of a thorough and organised process to ensure delivery of high quality & timely RfPs; pre pitch intelligence, internal preparation and briefings
• work closely across the firm, leveraging our capabilities in global markets, global banking and wealth management to ensure we deliver OneUBS to our clients

jobs.title: Global Markets - Execution Sales
jobs.description:
Do you have strong relationships with macro hedge funds in Asia?
Can you turn macro views into actionable trade ideas and client revenues?
Can you build internal relationships with colleagues to cross sell macro products?
We’re looking for a Macro Sales professional to:
• manage relationships with institutional macro clients, primarily hedge funds and institutional clients
• deliver high-quality execution across FX, rates and macro products, ensuring competitive pricing and timely flow execution
• generate trade ideas and market insights, translating macro developments into client-relevant strategies
• drive revenue growth by increasing wallet share and product penetration across your client base
• collaborate with trading and structuring teams to originate and execute tailored client solutions
• expand client coverage by onboarding new accounts and developing existing relationships
• coordinate across internal stakeholders to ensure seamless delivery from idea generation through to execution and follow-up

jobs.title: Global Markets - Electronic - Principal - Trader
jobs.description:
A CRB Quant Trader is responsible for developing quantitative models and managing the systematic execution of trades and orders on a principal basis.
The role focuses on generating revenue, providing liquidity to clients, and supporting client needs through disciplined risk and capital management.

Key Responsibilities:
• Generate revenue through development and timely/accurate execution and booking of trades/orders on a principal basis (generating P&L)
• Proactively keep abreast of market developments and trading opportunities; have a strong understanding of financial markets, instruments, and strategies
• Facilitate client order flow by providing liquidity via proprietary inventory (utilizing the firm’s capital) or accessing third party external offerings

• Adhere to all applicable regulations and internal policies including but not limited to quality of execution (example: best execution), trading activities (example: Volcker), pricing, hedging, trading-limits and compliance policies
• Manage broad range of risks, including but not limited to trading risk, execution risk, operational risk, compliance risk and conduct risk etc., evaluating options and making decisions
• Follow, adhere to and promote the UBS principles and behaviours acting with integrity, due skill, care, and diligence always
• Ensure escalation and disclosure of any information of which applicable regulators would reasonably expect notice
• Observe proper standards of market conduct while paying due regard to interests of customers and treating them fairly
• Where supervising other members of staff, ensure adherence to applicable regulations and internal policies via effective supervision and oversight with reference to the Principles of Good Supervision

Key Deliverables:
• Revenue generation (trading P&L, commissions, sales credits) and growing client business by provision of liquidity
• Strong contributions towards development of regional/global models driving the CRB business
• Adherence to regulations, compliance policies, desk policies, and guidelines as applicable to each market
• Risk management
• Conduct in accordance with UBS principles and behaviours along with regulatory expectations including escalation and disclosure of relevant issues
